diagnostics.message: `null_resource.delete_http_settings` runs a destroy-time local-exec that deletes the backend HTTP settings, which reference health probes. In Azure Application Gateway a probe cannot be removed while an HTTP setting still references it, so during teardown the HTTP settings must be deleted first. The resource's `depends_on` lists `null_resource.set_probe` (a create-time resource that does nothing on destroy) instead of `null_resource.delete_probe`, so no destroy ordering is established and the probe may be deleted before the settings that reference it (its `on_failure = fail` would then abort the destroy). It should depend on `null_resource.delete_probe`.

`null_resource.delete_http_listener` deletes the HTTP listeners, which reference the frontend ports. A frontend port cannot be deleted while a listener still uses it, so the listeners must be torn down before the frontend port. The resource's `depends_on` lists `null_resource.set_frontend_port` (a create-only resource whose destroy provisioner does nothing) instead of `null_resource.delete_frontend_port`, so no destroy ordering exists and `delete_frontend_port` may run first, failing on a still-referenced port (`on_failure = fail`). It should depend on `null_resource.delete_frontend_port`.
